title: HUMMBL Tuple_MM_Applied — Mental Model Application Record
description: Governance receipt for a single Base120 operator application. Records which MM operator was invoked, over which WM state, by whom, under what delegation authority, and what the outcome was. Implements the Apply protocol: Apply : MM_Operator × WM_State × MM_Context → (WM_State' × GovernanceTuple × Justification). Status: EXPERIMENTAL — promoted to core when G8 Apply protocol reaches [VALIDATED].

time.description: ISO8601 UTC timestamp of operator application

previous_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the previous tuple in this governance chain (Layer 4)

args_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of tuple_data for integrity verification (Layer 4)

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature over canonical JSON of tuple_data (Layer 4)

operator.description: The Base120 operator that was applied

code.description: Operator code in FAMILY.NN format (e.g. RE.04, DE.07)

family.description: Base120 family: P=Perspective, IN=Inversion, CO=Composition, DE=Decomposition, RE=Recursion, SY=Meta-Systems

arity.description: Number of WM state inputs consumed

mutates.description: Whether this operator mutates WM state (false = read-only analysis). Conditional: when true, tuple_data.wm_state_after MUST be present and invoker.dct_id MUST be present; when false, wm_state_after MUST be omitted (wm_state_before is the unchanged-state convention).

invoker.description: Context of who/what invoked this operator. Note: dct_id is conditionally required when operator.mutates=true (enforced by tuple_data.allOf below).

task_id.description: Task this operator invocation belongs to

dct_id.description: DCT token_id authorizing this invocation. Conditionally required when operator.mutates=true.

parent_tuple_id.description: ID of the tuple that triggered this operator application

invocation_depth.description: Recursive invocation depth (0 = direct human request). Bounded by G3 DEPTH_BOUND per op class.

belonging_score.description: BKI belonging score at invocation time (optional; used for BKI-gated operators)

wm_state_before.description: Snapshot of WM state before operator application (Layer 3: WM snapshot reference)

snapshot_ref.description: Reference to full WM state snapshot (hash or ID). Full state stored externally.

wm_state_after.description: Snapshot of WM state after operator application. Conditionally required when operator.mutates=true; MUST be omitted when operator.mutates=false (wm_state_before serves as the unchanged-state record).

version.description: WM state version identifier after mutation (must be > wm_state_before.version)

snapshot_ref.description: Reference to full WM state snapshot after mutation

delta_summary.description: Human-readable summary of what changed in WM state

justification.description: Why this operator was applied and what it produced

reason.description: Why this specific MM operator was selected for this WM state

output_summary.description: What the operator produced (structured output, not prose)

alternatives_considered.description: Other operators considered but not applied

confidence.description: Invoking agent's confidence in operator selection (0.0–1.0)

trust_at_invocation.description: Trust score τ at invocation time (G3 trust-decay model). Used to verify invocation_depth did not exceed DEPTH_BOUND.

depth_bound_used.description: The DEPTH_BOUND value that applied to this operator class at invocation trust. Logged for audit.

wm_state_after.delta_summary: Applied recursive decomposition to governance tuple spec; extracted 3 sub-schemas from monolithic contract schema

justification.reason: Contract schema had grown to 47 fields; RE.04 (recursive decomposition) was selected to identify natural compositional layers
justification.output_summary: 3-layer envelope model identified: universal (id/time), governance (state/drift/tier), domain (per-family). Validated against 26 existing examples.
